title: Reviewed instruction stand-in adapter
summary: Compile the reviewed agent/v1 instruction file and construct a model-step profile inside Lumeri's host frame. The adapter changes only instruction text, preserving the product's token and cost ceilings.

replaceability.why: The adapter and layering machinery are the Host foundation. If this machinery could be replaced by a creator layer, automatic fallback to the original could not be guaranteed. The Lucs carried by open protocols have their own replacement classes.
replaceability.decided: Acrab, self-Luc spec v0.3, 2026-10-18; interface charter rule 6, 2026-10-22

reach.notes: Trusted Host machinery, not authority granted to a Luc. Package calls remain bounded by their resolved permissions, Host APIs and editable scope.

operations.name: compile_package
operations.notes: No deadline. Requires agent.replace only, no APIs, editable none, valid short name and English instruction letters; UTF-8 instructions <=2400 bytes. ValueError maps at Host load.

operations.name: instructions
operations.notes: No deadline is enforced by this synchronous Python seam. Retrying a read observes the current state.

operations.name: agent_view

output.description: origin=lumeri, or origin=luc with capability/name/title/luc/review; conflict includes candidates; fallback includes layer/code.

operations.notes: No deadline. Conflict code is returned as metadata; two active stand-ins means neither answers.

operations.name: stand_in_profile

output.description: AgentStepProfile or None; profile representation belongs to the agent area.

operations.notes: No deadline. Raises StandInBroken before model reservation when instructions/profile break; Worker decides the original fallback. No active single stand-in returns None. The opaque AgentStepProfile output is not a JSON wire value; its cross-area interface id has not yet been supplied, so no foreign shape is duplicated.

invariants.text: A stand-in replaces instructions only; Host frame, product, maximum tokens and cost ceiling remain Lumeri's.

break: The operation rejects invalid input, integrity, authority or binding state as described by its operation.

conformance.notes: Existing tests listed here were inspected, not run for this documentation task. The area checker validates the contract files; it does not exercise runtime behavior.

known_deviations.text: The inventory's agent no-fallback claim predates StandInBroken and the per-start latch now in LucInteractions; this adapter alone still raises, and its caller owns fallback.

open_questions.text: The agent area must supply the interface id for AgentStepProfile so this opaque Python result can name its owning interface without guessing an id.
